套裝頁會列出這套有哪幾件，點一下就打開那件；單品頁的「所屬套裝」可以點回套裝。: A set’s page lists the pieces in it — tap one to open it. On a piece’s page, tap “Part of set” to go back to the set.
類別篩選的「配件」包含圍巾、領結、眼鏡、包包、道具和其他。: The “Accessories” filter includes scarves, bow ties, glasses, bags, props and other.
帶娃娃去公司或學校，選「🏢 上班」，衣服可以不選（詳細看「陪伴日常：陪上班、上學: Took your doll to work or school? Choose “🏢 Work” — picking clothes is optional (see “Daily companion: work & school”).
帶娃娃去公司或學校，記穿搭時選「🏢 上班」：衣服可以不選，只記今天一起上班；不算: When your doll comes to the office or school, choose “🏢 Work” when logging. Clothes are optional — you can just record that you went together. It doesn’t count as an outing or in footprints.
記過一次之後，上班日早上首頁會問「今天也一起上班嗎？」，點一下就記好；國定假日或: After the first time, Home asks “Coming to work today too?” on work-day mornings — one tap logs it. On holidays or days off, tap “Day off 🌴”.
到 設定 → 陪上班，可以選固定星期幾上班；排班制的話，在月曆上一天一天點。: In Settings → Work buddy, pick your fixed work days, or tap days on the calendar if you work shifts.
不是上班日也帶娃娃去了，會記成「🌙 加班」（上學、上課叫補課），會跳出鼓勵，也可: Brought your doll on a day off? It’s logged as “🌙 Overtime” (extra class for school) with a little cheer, and you can drop a thank-you note in the star jar.
早上上班、晚上讀書，可以按「＋ 新增日常」分開記（最多 3 個）；名字可以改成上: Work in the morning and study at night? Tap “＋ Add routine” to track them separately (up to 3). Rename them to school, study, part-time job… or anything you like. One is fine too.
娃娃履歷會寫他陪你幾天；會員分析和年度回顧可以看誰是你的最佳同事、加班夥伴，名字: The doll profile shows how many days they came along. Member insights and the year in review show your best coworker and overtime buddy — renamed to best classmate or study buddy to match.
每種小卡都可以選奶油、玫瑰、夜色三種顏色，貼文 4:5 或限動 9:16，也可以: Every card comes in Cream, Rose or Night, as a 4:5 post or 9:16 story, and you can add a line of text (it wraps, up to 3 lines).
點進娃娃是一張履歷：姓名、尺寸、到家日、生日、來源；下面是紀念日和整理紀錄。要改: Tap a doll to see their profile: name, size, home date, birthday and origin, with anniversaries and care records below. To edit details or accessories, tap ✏️ at the top right.
很珍惜的娃娃可以按 ✏️ 標記「💝 紀念收藏」，寫下紀念原因。: For a treasured doll, tap ✏️ to mark them “💝 Keepsake” and write down why.
娃娃附的尾巴、耳朵、頭飾，按 ✏️ 記在「附的配件」；有配件才會顯示在娃娃頁。: Tails, ears or headpieces that came with the doll: tap ✏️ and add them under “Accessories”. They show on the doll page only if there are any.
會員分析有年度回顧「娃娃的一年」（可以做成分享小卡）、搭配分析（同一套的零件不互: Member insights include the year in review “A Year with My Dolls” (shareable as a card), pairing analysis (pieces of the same set don’t count against each other), set rankings, each doll’s outfits, how many seasonal and holiday pieces were worn, favorite color combos, outfit habits, and spending: monthly spend, cost per wear, and how much you earned back selling clothes (clothes only).
套裝不管拆成幾件，價格只算一次；套裝裡的單品全部穿到才算整套穿過一次。: However many pieces a set is split into, its price counts once. A set counts as worn only when every piece in it is worn.
外觀可以選淺色、深色，或跟著手機自動切換；娃娃月曆一週從星期日或星期一開始，也在: Appearance can be light, dark, or follow your phone. You can also choose whether the doll calendar starts on Sunday or Monday here.
有問題或想要的功能，到「意見回饋」寫信告訴我；「給你的一封信」可以再看一次第一次: Questions or feature ideas? Write to me from “Feedback”. “A letter for you” shows the letter from your first visit again.
右上 ✏️ 改資料、配件: Tap ✏️ at the top right to edit details and accessories
